automated.summary: All four required leaves for statement-model execute and pass, each proven by the junit report naming the LEAF rather than by an exit code: a negative control with a nonexistent leaf name also exits 0 and reports tests=1 pass=1, but its testcase name is the FILE PATH (Node's file-level pass, D-0024's false-green), while each real run's testcase name is the required id verbatim. Re-run at the FINAL reviewed tree after three review rounds, the gated D-0008 host proof runs 18/18 with 0 failures and 0 skipped, and the dead-port control fails 7 gated leaves with ECONNREFUSED, so the green run is real database work. The new statement projection proof asserts EXACT values rather than non-emptiness: 81 leaf/month rows with distinct (leaf_key, month) keys - the no-fan-out assertion - Actual totalling 11512712.07 and Budget 10050136.29, and the three multi-component GLs split across their nursery stages (4.5|50001605, 5.3|50001605 and 6.1|50001605; 7.1|50001901 and 7.2|50001901) instead of summing onto one line. The six pre-existing gated proofs pass unchanged, which is decision 0022's promise that the (gl_code, month) relation was not disturbed.
